newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar finishes lower in modest trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar finishes lower in modest trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly lower against its U.S. counterpart on Friday on late U.S. dollar buying, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.497 against Thursday's T$27.492 close. Turnover was a modest US$152 million.

The Taiwan dollar rose in early trade amid rising inflows of foreign funds, dealers said. The Securities and Exchange Commission has said its approval on foreign fund inflows would likely hit a new monthly record in September. "But the rate was offset by routine U.S. dollar demand from local banks," said a dealer. A range of T$27.48-52 was seen.-- Alice Hung (5080815)
